svg.title: Traditional sweep versus CORTEX scan pattern
svg.desc: Illustrative schematic comparing a blind triangular sweep with an adaptive dwell-and-lock scheduler on the same emitters
svg.text: Scan Pattern: Traditional Sweep vs CORTEX
fixed triangular sweep · blind to emitter activity
dwell-and-lock on hits · jumps to stale or promising bands
Illustrative hand-scripted schematic on identical emitters, not measured data. Real GUI capture and 1,000-seed results follow below.
